"WEEE! (but wide)


The Wide Tilted Conveyor is a structure that can be bought from The Oak Depot. It is a wide sloping straight section of conveyor belt.

Details

The Wide Tilted Conveyor is otherwise functionally similar to the Tilted Conveyor. It is simply 2 studs wider. Like the Wide Straight Conveyor, it can be resized to be as short as 6 studs in length, or as long as 12 studs in length.
